info.title: Athenaeum Library Management System API
info.description: API documentation for Athenaeum covering verification-first authentication, catalog, physical inventory, circulation rules, reservations, fines and Razorpay payments, notifications, staff reports, audit logs, and user administration.

post.description: Creates an unverified account and sends one verification email. Registration does not create an authenticated session.
Verifies the email token, marks the account verified, creates access/refresh tokens and sets the refresh-token cookie.
Requests one new verification email for an unverified account. The endpoint is public and protected by resend cooldown/rate limiting.
Authenticates a verified, active account and sets the refresh-token cookie. Unverified accounts are rejected outside the test environment.

403.description: Email unverified, account suspended, or account temporarily locked

post.description: Rotates the refresh token using the httpOnly lms_refresh_token cookie.

401.description: Refresh token missing, invalid, expired, revoked or reused

post.description: Revokes the current refresh token and clears the refresh cookie.

400.description: Current password incorrect or validation failed

post.description: Admin or librarian only. Physical copies are added separately through the circulation inventory endpoint.

403.description: Membership, overdue-loan, fine-limit or account restriction

409.description: No available copy or conflicting reservation state

post.description: Admin or librarian only. Can return the copy in good or damaged condition; overdue fines may be generated.

400.description: Renewal blocked by due date, renewal limit, loan state or reservation queue

get.summary: List physical copies for a book

patch.description: Admin or librarian only. Supports available, damaged and under_repair transitions.

409.description: Duplicate active reservation or conflicting availability

403.description: Fine does not belong to current user

500.description: Payment provider is not configured or unavailable

400.description: Invalid payment details/signature or fine state

403.description: Fine does not belong to current user

400.description: Fine cannot be waived or validation failed

post.description: Admin or librarian only. Executes the scheduled circulation-maintenance logic on demand.

patch.description: Admin or librarian only. Staff cannot change their own membership status. Non-active status revokes active refresh sessions.
Admin only. Admins cannot change their own role, and the final admin cannot be demoted.

400.description: Invalid/self role change or final-admin protection

password.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase and a number

totalCopies.description: Catalog field only; physical inventory is added through /api/v1/borrow/copies

userId.description: Optional staff checkout target; normal members omit this
